values.subject: Connect production alerts to the operations queue
values.description: Route actionable application alerts into one retry-safe operational workflow.

values.subject: Run the quarterly restore drill

values.resolution_summary: The demo restore completed and the fictional service acceptance checks passed.
values.internal_notes: Demo note: retained as an archived example after closure.

values.subject: Review editor permissions after handover
values.description: Confirm that fictional editor roles can update learning content without reaching administrator-only settings.
values.internal_notes: Demo note: use this request to inspect field and action permissions.

values.subject: Confirm the recovery review scope
values.description: Agree on a fictional, non-sensitive evidence set for the proposed recovery review.
values.internal_notes: Demo note: no credentials, patient data, or production topology belongs in the fixture.

values.subject: Document the integration retry policy
values.description: Document how a failed fictional notification is retried without creating duplicate work.
values.resolution_summary: The example now records an idempotency key and a bounded retry outcome.
values.internal_notes: Demo note: the process remains entirely local.
